title: Extension of a Home-Delivery Transition Supply While an Exception Request Awaits Decision (Formulary Benefit)
content:
Under the Formulary Benefit, a home-delivery transition supply is extended while an exception request for the drug is waiting for its decision. The member's exception history for the drug is read.

**Undecided request.** A request is awaiting decision when the history carries more exception requests for the drug than decisions (approvals and denials) and withdrawals on them.

| Request awaiting decision | Priority on the latest request for the drug | Extension added |
|---|---|---|
| yes | expedited | **3** days |
| yes | standard | **7** days |
| no | any | none |

The extension is added to the supply before the supply is held between zero and the formulary's maximum days supply for one transition fill.

*Hypothetical histories.*
- Two requests for the drug, one denial, latest request standard. One request is waiting, so 7 days are added.
- One request, expedited, statement received, no decision yet. 3 days are added.
- One request that has been withdrawn. Nothing is waiting, so no extension applies.
